clue.text: Sound of organic matter is overwhelming half the population
Atomic region with particle that's between two states
Father's attempt to make dessert
Took a whiff of fish
Implored tender bats to accept swallow
King imprisons lunatic, narco and traitor
Woman goes over noise of gun in shooting match
Key in Star Wars cantina, for one
For instance, taking time to pause
Tavern with hint of exotic aroma is at that awkward stage
Butler's vicious threat: withholding bit of alcohol
React badly to provision
Televised teen drama with risqué religious state
Check for visor
A pretty fish makes a figure that's not quite right?
Painful inflammation before I give up bread or pasta
Draining yellow in variegated pigment
Outrageous comic set is superficial
Oldfangled order: great cocktail
Name an insect, tail and head overlapping another insect
Hit friends back
Glorify a 1975 Eagles hit on the radio
Rocky shore is habitat for Northern waders
Cardinal to kick around a sheep with love
Afterthought about, for example, pins
Paces among ancient empires
Something that sticks like a computer virus?
Start to generate late-arriving blanket remorse
Fried bacon with maid from Phnom Penh, perhaps
Sacred text assembled out of letters from Castile
